title: Design System: Creekstone Ventures Founder Signal Field

display.purpose: Centered hero name; changes from 12vw to 8vw at the 768px breakpoint.

headline.purpose: Section names, deployed VC names, and dormant dossier headings.

body.purpose: Manifesto, chronology, investor biographies, and dormant forensic logs.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, statuses, dates, controls, tags, and node subtitles.

shadows.name: hero-halo
shadows.purpose: White drop-shadow behind hero identity and large inverse headings.

shadows.name: pixel-lift
shadows.purpose: Default hard elevation for deployable project cards.

shadows.name: pixel-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation and glow for project cards.

shadows.name: glass-panel-offset
shadows.purpose: Desktop forensic dossier panels; mobile reduces the offset to 4px.

shadows.name: ghost-card-offset
shadows.purpose: Selected card while it travels into forensic detail mode.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Yellow dossier tab and milestone signaling.

motion.name: loader-enter
motion.purpose: Raises the loader text into view.

motion.name: loader-exit
motion.purpose: Moves the full loader field beyond the top edge.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Controls the continuous long-form scroll from one GSAP ticker clock; Lenis is never advanced by a second requestAnimationFrame loop.

motion.name: chapter-hold
motion.purpose: Pins Hero, Agent, Team, and terminal Perspectives / Contact while a single 3px full-width bottom charge line fills to 100%; the chapter then releases, the line remains full through transition, and resets when the next full screen takes over. Portfolio retains its horizontal pin, downstream holds register after that pin is measured, and progress reads from ordered controller ranges.

motion.name: timeline-particle-orbit
motion.purpose: Moves the Creekstone mark through a deterministic eased orbit on the black Portfolio field without time-based jitter or competing downstream scene writes.

motion.name: portfolio-integer-clock
motion.purpose: Rolls the background count vertically from 1 through 10 whenever focus crosses into the next investment dossier.

motion.name: founder-voice-pin
motion.purpose: Cuts a verified founder voice slip into the active portfolio dossier, then drops its compact gold pin with a short needle near the right edge; reduced-motion mode presents the slip without transition.

motion.name: agent-runtime-cut-in
motion.purpose: Introduces the dark Agent Runtime Chamber around the central gold Creekstone WebGL particle mark, full-color Yihao identity dossier, and hard-edge live console.

motion.name: underline-wipe
motion.purpose: Directional hover underline on evidence headings.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Physical hover lift for undeployed investor credentials.

motion.name: card-deploy
motion.purpose: Two-stage credential launch into a neutral-geometry deployment coordinate; Lenis is synchronized before takeoff and impact shake stays isolated on the transform-free slot.

motion.name: folder-stack
motion.purpose: Reorders accomplishment folders after a flip.

motion.name: node-follow
motion.purpose: Preserves the original ecosystem interaction while adding depth: 1.5× inverse pointer travel, a 580px cosine scale lens, nonlinear center pull, 0.08-frame inertia, independent 1.2–4.1px float phases, sub-degree rotation, and a smoothstep alpha falloff from 56% of the lens radius to its edge.

narrative.overview:
This is an Experience-mode venture platform rendered as a live technical field rather than a conventional fund website. Creekstone's three-ring gold mark is reconstructed as a volumetric point cloud across the identity chamber, a pinned portfolio reel translates vertical scroll into ten investment dossiers, verified founder voices are pinned to their matching company records, and a black credential table introduces the three-person investment team through full-color deployable name cards. A reactive source field closes on eleven real Creekstone perspectives beside a functional founder contact panel and integrated footer. The design is deliberately computational, editorial, monochrome, and physical.

Creekstone's supplied content is the factual authority while the Thomas Deng reference remains a motion and interaction reference. Black and white establish the world; gold identifies Creekstone; original portfolio-company colors and all people portraits remain in full color inside controlled surfaces. The former project forensic overlay and stacked-folder runtime remain dormant in the codebase for later reuse.
keyCharacteristics: A binary white/black field that changes state during the scroll narrative
A Space Grotesk-only typography system with dense display commands and light, measured narrative text
Creekstone particle mark in saturated golden yellow #e8b82f on the Hero and terminal chapter, with a softened aura, telemetry labels, grid traces, scanlines, and low-opacity noise
A dark Agent Runtime Chamber bridging the warm-ivory hero to the black computational dossier world
Yihao’s full-color identity dossier separated from a hard-edge live console by precise responsive geometry
Full-screen chapter holds resolved by a single 3px bottom charge line
Ten investments expressed as a black-from-entry pinned deal-room reel with a 1–10 vertical clock counter, deterministic Creekstone particle orbit, and verified founder voice slips
Three investors expressed as full-color physical credentials that deploy into a left-hand slot and reveal biographies at right
The former project forensic overlay and stacked-folder interaction preserved as dormant backup code
Eleven real perspectives expressed as a pointer-reactive square source field beside functional Contact and an integrated footer

rules.name: The Reviewed Handoff Rule
rules.body: In the founder handoff card, show the exact content and sharing disclosure before decisions; saving is not consent, and changed content must be saved and reviewed again before confirmation.

rules.name: The Handoff State Truth Rule
rules.body: In the founder handoff card, describe only the known state: an uncertain response requires synchronization, and a submitted receipt does not imply human acceptance, a scheduled meeting, or a sent notification.

rules.name: The Binary Field Rule
rules.body: Major chapters resolve to white-on-black or black-on-white; gray supports hierarchy but never becomes a competing theme.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Yellow and green communicate state or milestone only. They do not become decorative gradients or broad surface fills.

rules.name: The Single-Family Contrast Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk owns the entire interface. Weight, scale, tracking, case, and line-height—not a neutral secondary face—separate identity commands from explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Telemetry Case Rule
rules.body: Interface metadata and actions are uppercase and tracked. Human narrative copy stays in normal case.

rules.name: The Functional Number Rule
rules.body: Do not prefix section headings with source-document ordinals. Numbers appear only when they communicate live progress, an investment position, or a verified quantity.

rules.name: The Reference Geometry Rule
rules.body: Preserve horizontal viewport clipping during portfolio progression, the physical team credential fan, and the dark-to-ivory visual overlap between the Team and Perspectives / Contact transition. These are accepted traits of the binding reference, not generic responsive defects to normalize.

rules.name: The Charged Release Rule
rules.body: A held full-screen chapter cannot release before its single bottom charge line reaches 100%. Keep the 3px line full through the transition, then reset it only when the next full screen owns the viewport. Chapter state comes from ordered ScrollTrigger ranges rather than transient viewport geometry.

rules.name: The Verified Voice Rule
rules.body: Pin a founder voice slip only when the source author exactly matches the portfolio founder. Preserve the quote verbatim and portrait in full color, keep the slip subordinate to the company dossier, and do not invent voice coverage for unmatched companies.

rules.name: The Hard Evidence Rule
rules.body: Resting artifacts use crisp borders and hard offset shadows; diffuse glow appears only during hover, verification, scanning, or active machine state.

rules.name: The Shape Semantics Rule
rules.body: Squares hold evidence, sources, and controls; the cursor circle represents live attention; pills are reserved for compact skills.

dos: Do preserve the public reference as the binding visual and behavioral authority.
Do keep the black/white chapter inversions, Creekstone particle mark, pinned portfolio reel, deployable team credential ritual, and reactive perspective field together as one continuous experience.
Do preserve horizontal viewport clipping during portfolio progression, the physical team credential fan, and the dark-to-ivory overlap between Team and Perspectives / Contact.
Do give Hero, Agent, Team, and terminal Perspectives / Contact a 0.72-viewport hold runway while retaining Portfolio’s horizontal pin.
Do keep perspective titles and links sourced from Creekstone and keep the founder mailto action functional.
Do keep every investor portrait in full color and reveal the selected biography beside or below its credential.
Do retain the former forensic overlay and stacked-folder runtime as disabled backup code.
Do hold each chapter until the single 3px full-width bottom charge line reaches 100%, keep it full through transition, and reset only when the next full screen takes over.
Do keep Yihao’s mobile portrait in color at 36vw and begin the console at 64%.
Do attach source-verified founder voices only to their exact matching company dossiers and keep every portrait in full color.
Do use yellow, red, and green only for their observed state and milestone roles.
Do keep sharp borders, hard pixel offsets, scanlines, grids, and noise at their restrained observed opacity.
donts: Don't reinterpret the portfolio into a conventional résumé grid, marketing landing page, or dashboard.
Don't round team credentials, command buttons, deployment slots, forensic panels, or dossier frames.
Don't reintroduce Inter or another neutral UI face; preserve the Space Grotesk weight/scale hierarchy, uppercase telemetry voice, and tracked labels.
Don't “fix” accepted clipping, cropping, or transition overlap when matching this reference.
Don't release a held full-screen chapter before its bottom charge line is complete, reset the line during the inter-chapter transition, or grayscale any founder portrait.
Don't infer, rewrite, or attach a founder voice to a company without an exact source match.
Don't add decorative color, gradients, soft ambient card shadows, or unrelated illustration.
Don't turn Perspectives into a generic article-card grid or Contact into a non-functional terminal simulation.
